answer: New identities must complete a costly proof-of-burn, and peers cross-check reputation against a shared oasis ledger where every action is signed. Each agent stakes a pearl of verified work history to register. A sybil farm must replicate this stake for each fake identity, so attack cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. Like a raven marking its cache, the ledger flags duplicate behavioral fingerprints, making mass registration economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0205's threat model.
